about: Changes applied in order to an empty store. After each, the ref main names the step's ref, and the store has gained exactly the objects listed, each at its name. A step that adds nothing makes no commit.

steps.about: a first commit: three holons born, one name given
one holon changed, one left as it was: only the changed one gets a version
61 more make 64 holons, which one leaf still holds
one more makes 65, and the leaf becomes a branch over the last character of the ids
65 holons whose ids all end in Z: that leaf passes 64 and branches over the second character from the end
only names change: one taken away, one given; the tree is shared whole
only what a holon is an instance of changes
a change that changes nothing makes no commit, and the ref stays
three holons taken out: the 66 ending in Z fall to 64, and their branch becomes a leaf again, as if the others had never been
